title: Why Do We Travel? Pack Your Bags!

leo.name: Leo
leo.persona: cheerful 11-year-old boy, curious and full of energy

focusWords.kidDefinition: To go to other places, often far away.
examples: We like to travel by train in the summer.
Some people travel to learn new languages.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A person who visits a place on holiday.
examples: The tourist took a photo of the old bridge.
Tourists love the blue sea in Greece.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A small thing you buy to remember a place.
examples: I bought a souvenir of a red lighthouse.
A postcard is a cheap souvenir.
focusWords.greekHint: αναμνηστικό: something to remember a trip

focusWords.kidDefinition: Staying outdoors, often in a tent, for fun.
examples: We went camping by the lake last summer.
Camping is fun when you sleep in a tent.
focusWords.greekHint: κάμπινγκ: sleeping outdoors in a tent

focusWords.kidDefinition: A small wooden house, often in the forest.
examples: The wooden cabin had two small rooms.
They rested in a cabin after a long walk.
focusWords.greekHint: καλύβα: a small house in the mountains

focusWords.kidDefinition: A fire outdoors, used for cooking and warmth.
examples: We sang songs around the campfire at night.
Please never leave a campfire burning.
focusWords.greekHint: φωτιά κατασκήνωσης: the fire at camp

focusWords.kidDefinition: Walking for a long time on hills or mountains.
examples: On Sunday, we went hiking up a big hill.
Hiking is a good way to see nature.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A large old building with thick walls and towers.
examples: The castle on the hill is very old.
Knights lived in the castle long ago.
focusWords.greekHint: κάστρο: a big old building with towers

focusWords.kidDefinition: A list of questions people answer to give information.
examples: Please fill in this questionnaire about your holidays.
The questionnaire had ten simple questions.
focusWords.greekHint: ερωτηματολόγιο: a set of questions to answer

focusWords.kidDefinition: What happens because of something, like the end of a game.
examples: The result of the game was a big surprise.
What was the result of your test?
focusWords.greekHint: αποτέλεσμα: what comes out of an action

lines.text: Hello, friends! I am Lingo, and I love exploring the world.
Have you ever slept in a tent under the stars?
Some people travel to see old castles. Others go hiking in the mountains.
Today we ask a big question: why do we travel?

question.text: Where would you like to go, and why?

caption.text: Leo and Maya are going camping in the forest.

speech.text: Look! There is a cabin near the river. We can sleep there tonight.
Great! Let's go hiking first, then find wood for the campfire.

caption.text: In the village, they stop in front of an old castle.

speech.text: Wow, look at that castle! Many tourists come here to take photos.
I love to travel and learn. I will buy a souvenir for my grandma.

caption.text: Back at school, the class answers a travel questionnaire.

speech.text: Our questionnaire asked: why do you travel? Most people said to learn.
The result is clear. Travel makes people happy and curious.

prompt.text: When I grow up, I want to ____ to many different countries.

explain.text: Travel is the verb for going to other places.

prompt.text: Listen: castle. Which picture is it?

explain.text: A castle is a big old building with towers and thick walls.
A campfire is the fire we make outside to cook and stay warm.

prompt.text: Every summer, a ____ visits our city with a big map.

explain.text: A tourist is a person who visits a place on holiday.

prompt.text: Camping means sleeping in a tent outdoors, for fun.

explain.text: Camping is a fun holiday outside, often in a tent.

prompt.text: Which word is NOT something you do outdoors on a trip?

explain.text: Hiking, camping and travel are things we do; a cabin is a place.

prompt.text: I bought a small ____ from the shop to remember our trip.

explain.text: A souvenir is something you buy to remember a place.

prompt.text: Please answer all the questions in the ____.

explain.text: A questionnaire is a list of questions people answer.

prompt.text: The ____ of our test was very good.

explain.text: The result is what happens at the end, like your score.

prompt.text: A cabin is a big city hotel with many floors.

explain.text: A cabin is a small wooden house, often in the forest.

lines.text: Time to play! Find the matching pairs of picture and word.
Say each word aloud as you turn the card over.

prompt.text: Tell your partner about a trip you would like to make.

frames: On holiday, I would like to go ___ because ___.
I would buy a souvenir of ___.

model.text: I want to travel to Italy. I would like to go camping near a lake, because I love nature. I would buy a souvenir of a small blue boat.

lines.text: Fantastic work, travellers! You now know ten powerful words for your journeys.
Next time, we will explore the big question with Leo and Maya.

exitTicket.text: Name one thing you can do at a campfire.
Why do people travel? Use one new word in your answer.
